name: Checkbox Survey
description_en:
Checkbox is survey software offered as a managed cloud service or an on-premises deployment. It combines a no-code editor, survey logic, distribution campaigns, user profiles, reporting and access controls. Hosting choice is central to the product, not a synonym for open-source licensing.

The current pricing page places response and seat allowances on cloud tiers even though the homepage broadly advertises unlimited responses. Use the selected plan’s explicit quota for procurement, and establish who maintains the infrastructure if choosing on-premises.
description_zh:
Checkbox 提供托管云端或本地部署的问卷软件，组合无代码编辑器、问卷逻辑、分发活动、用户资料、报表与访问控制。托管方式是核心选择，不等于开源许可。

虽然首页泛称无限回答，当前定价页仍为云端档位列出回答与席位额度。采购应按具体套餐额度判断；选择本地部署时要明确基础设施由谁维护。

core_features.explanation_en: All listed cloud tiers include question types, advanced logic and custom branding.
core_features.explanation_zh: 所列云端档位均包含题型、高级逻辑与品牌定制。

core_features.explanation_en: Cloud regions and a separate on-premises deployment are offered.
core_features.explanation_zh: 提供云端地区选择及独立本地部署。

core_features.name_zh: 分档 API 与身份控制
core_features.explanation_en: Business adds REST API/webhooks; Enterprise adds SAML and audit logs; on-premises adds AD/LDAP.
core_features.explanation_zh: Business 增加 REST API／webhook，Enterprise 增加 SAML 与审计，本地版增加 AD／LDAP。

use_cases.basis: Editorial task and fit judgments grounded in the attached primary sources; no observed deployment.

Research scope.en: Public documentation and commercial access reviewed; examples are proposed evaluation workflows.

target_audience.organization_sizes_en: Select by workflow, volume and governance needs; no universal size claim.
target_audience.organization_sizes_zh: 按流程、用量与治理需求选择，不宣称适合所有规模。

steps.en: Cloud hosting can be selected in the US, Canada, Australia or EU according to the pricing FAQ. On-premises gives the customer its own servers, domain and mail server, with implementation support. Confirm supported versions, upgrade responsibility, backups and restore process for a self-managed installation. Neither an on-premises option nor API access establishes an open-source license; the exact license terms were not verified.
steps.zh: 定价 FAQ 列云端可选美国、加拿大、澳大利亚或欧盟。本地版使用客户自己的服务器、域名与邮件服务器，并提供实施支持。自管安装需确认受支持版本、升级责任、备份和恢复流程。本地部署和 API 访问均不能证明开源许可；具体许可条款未核实。

items.en: Checkbox may suit organizations needing flexible hosting and sophisticated surveys. A cloud-only form builder serves a simpler task; self-hosting adds operational work. The headline unlimited-response claim conflicts with lower cloud-tier quotas. Data retention policies, SSO, custom agreements and audit logs are not uniformly available across every tier. A security or healthcare claim on a page is not a signed BAA or a verified implementation. Delivery retries, backup recovery and integration failure handling remain untested.
items.zh: 需要灵活托管和复杂问卷的组织可考虑 Checkbox；纯云表单处理更简单任务，自托管会增加运维。首页无限回答宣传与低档云套餐额度存在冲突。保留策略、SSO、自定义协议及审计日志并非每档都相同。安全或医疗宣传不等于已签署 BAA 或已验证实施。投递重试、备份恢复与集成失败处理尚未测试。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The USD page shows Solo at $30/month for one user and 120,000 responses/year, Team at $100/month for five users and 300,000/year, and Business at $1,800/year with five users and one million/year. Monthly/annual selectors are present, so confirm the checkout cadence behind the displayed Solo and Team rates. Enterprise and on-premises are quoted. A 14-day cloud trial requires no card; no permanent free plan was established. SMS/WhatsApp invitations are an add-on, and extra Business users cost more.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 美元页展示 Solo 每月 30 美元、一人、每年 120,000 回答；Team 每月 100 美元、五人、每年 300,000；Business 每年 1,800 美元、五人、一百万回答。页面有月付／年付选择，应在结账确认 Solo 和 Team 展示费率对应的周期。Enterprise 与本地版询价。云端 14 天试用免信用卡，未建立永久免费档。短信／WhatsApp 邀请是附加项，Business 额外用户另收费。

review_notes: Original English synthesis with section-aligned Chinese translation. Vendor documentation is not an independent performance test.
Hypothetical workflows and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. No directional alternative relationship has been approved.
Evidence text and SHA-256 metadata retained in .scratch/deep-research/batch-12/checkbox-survey-c50d206a/; no source text copied into public descriptions.

sections.en: A proposed service-quality project imports only approved contact data, builds a branching questionnaire, sends invitations and analyzes segment results. Dynamic profiles can personalize the experience, but review what identifiers appear in shared reports. If an integration is required, inspect Business or higher rather than relying on a homepage API label. Test incomplete responses, branching and a known invitation before scaling. This workflow was not executed for the profile.
sections.zh: 建议的服务质量项目只导入获准联系人数据，建立分支问卷、发送邀请并分析分群结果。动态资料可用于个性化，但需检查共享报表里出现哪些标识。若需集成，应检查 Business 或以上，不能只依赖首页 API 标签。扩展前测试部分回答、分支和一封已知邀请。本文未执行此流程。
